findings.location: Statement, first paragraph: the coordinate-speed condition |d\mathbf{x}/dt| <= c for V^0 > 0.
findings.evidence: The claim starts from a free vector V=(V^0,\mathbf V) in R^4 but does not define a curve or coordinate-velocity map that makes d\mathbf{x}/dt an object of V. Define v(V)=c\mathbf V/V^0 for V^0>0, then derive from eta(V,V)=-(V^0)^2+|\mathbf V|^2 that eta(V,V)<=0 iff |v(V)|<=c.
